name: Freedom Arrow — 0.9 (China)
description: Freedom Arrow 0.9: China (PLA) on the full 0.7.0-dev.58 game. 0.9.0-dev.43 (18 Nov): J-36 +60 points (415); recon CSK-131 back in PLAGF Motorized; CTL-181 NLOS and Blood Wolves CH-901 missiles cannot be shot down or stopped by APS; build code ignores an old ActualArrow entry in the Mod Manager; US door-stack loading screen fixed. Includes 0.9.0-dev.42 (start screen soldiers keep their legs), 0.9.0-dev.41 (deck drag-and-drop reorder, 4K start screen) and 0.9.0-dev.38 (Freedom Arrow loading screens, China voices). Needs Freedom Arrow — Models and Music 0.2.46.
